name: B10-0156/2024 – After § 48 – Am 5
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the UN Climate Change Conference 2024 in Baku, Azerbaijan (COP29)
part_text: 48a. Stresses the need to revise the European Green Deal to ensure that EU climate and environmental policies are based on pragmatism and wider scientific opinions, with a view to enhancing the competitiveness of EU businesses, while protecting the environment; calls on the Commission to properly evaluate not only the environmental, but also the social and economic impact of all EU climate and environmental policies;
